#: canopy-sandbox's template for runtime.overseer_cmd, which decides through canopy's tools and writes the journal
(DESIGN §24). The runs the overseer asks for start outside it, from the tick (DESIGN §40). canopy sandbox setup
copies it to ~/.config/canopy/sandbox/overseer.json; fill in your hosts there. Keys starting with # are
comments; @NAME@ strings are the paths canopy-sandbox fills in for each run.
Everything not listed is refused. Add your model provider's API host and your tracker's MCP endpoint. The
overseer reads GitHub through its MCP server, and pushes and fetches nothing, so github.com itself is not
The overseer starts in the workspace root. It reads the workspace and its state, and of the state writes only
the journal, its locks, and canopy's log (@JOURNAL@): not the private config, the agent definitions, or a
directory another run starts in, which canopy and its agents load later. Of canopy's own config it reads the
user file alone, never the listener's secret beside it; if XDG_CONFIG_HOME moves it, name it there instead.
canopy runs from its uv tool install, ~/.local/share/uv and ~/.local/bin: if yours is elsewhere under HOME,
add it. Caches go in @CACHE@, and OpenCode's data in @DATA@, with a copy of your logins: the overseer's own.
Never put one of your caches, or ~/.local/share/opencode, in allowWrite: your own tools, and OpenCode, would
run what the overseer left there.
